questions.question: How fast is the Wi-Fi at the villas?
answer_facts: 100 Mbps at Villa Sol and Casa Kokum
50 Mbps at The Cashew House and Monsoon Cottage

questions.question: yo, what do i do if the wifi drops?
answer_facts: restart the white router in the hall cupboard

questions.question: I was wondering if the power goes out, will the fridge still work?
answer_facts: Every villa has an inverter that keeps lights, fans, Wi-Fi and the fridge running for about 6 hours

questions.question: How long should I switch on the water heater before my shower?
answer_facts: Switch it on about 20 minutes before a shower
